newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria's Shara and EU Troika discuss Mideast peace.
newsitem.headline: Syria's Shara and EU Troika discuss Mideast peace.

text.p: Syrian Foreign Minister Farouq al-Shara opened talks on Saturday with the European Troika delegation headed by Irish Foreign Minister Dick Spring on how to advance Arab-Israeli peace talks.
Official sources said Shara, who arrived from Paris after holding talks with President Jacques Chirac over reviving the Middle East peace talks, welcomed Spring on arrival.

Members of the delegation from the Netherlands, Italy and the EU delegation arrived earlier in the day separately. They are scheduled to meet President Hafez al-Assad on Sunday before their departure.

Talks between Israel and its Arab neighbors are deadlocked, with right-wing Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu rejecting the concept of trading occupied Arab land for peace -- the basis of peace talks since 1991.
